__description: Project KBD hooks for the WSO2 FHIR Server. The three augment entries record successful KBD boundaries with the Karpathy progress recorder through a Node bridge, so recording works where the built-in python/shell entries do not (e.g. Windows) and every outcome lands in .prometheus/agent-ledger.jsonl. On Unix the built-in entries also run; the recorder is idempotent, so the second call reports `duplicate`. See openspec/specs/agent-tooling/karpathy-logging (decision D-005).
